svg.title: Average speeds closing in on an instant
svg.desc: A stone falls s(t) = 16t squared feet in t seconds. The crimson curve is s. Lines join the point P (1, 16) to points on the curve at t = 2, 1.5 and 1.2; their slopes, the average speeds, are 48, 40 and 35.2 feet per second. A dashed line through P has slope 32. A table lists average speeds over [1, 2], [1, 1.5], [1, 1.2], [1, 1.1], [1, 1.01] and [1, 1.001]: 48, 40, 35.2, 33.6, 32.16 and 32.016, closing in on 32 feet per second.
